limitation: S+/S- mainly separates intensity/history; PN and ORN differ but DNb05 contrast is small, and registered command threshold fails. This observation alone cannot identify the causal bottleneck or navigation.

A.mechanism: Input geometry: the original pair varied mainly common intensity, whereas bilateral steering may require changing signed antennal contrast at matched common intensity.
A.new_operation: Prospective finite-source pair with equal initial mean and opposite later L-R contrast; keep neuronal model and reader fixed.
A.legal_information: Prepared pose, existing Gaussian boundary and measured antennal positions only. No target heading/route to organism.
A.prediction: Committed ORN/PN lateral contrast and DNb05/command reversal grow together under matched common intensity.
A.falsifier: Lateral ORN/PN contrast is observed but DNb05/command remains below frozen prospective material threshold, or source pair cannot be matched at initial state.
A.control: Equal common intensity, same initial state/clock; reference engine only if native effect material.

B.mechanism: Internal transfer: contrast reaches PN but recurrent/intermediate transfer to the DNb05 rate target attenuates it.
B.new_operation: Offline sensitivity calculation from exact signed PN/DN net and target; then one bounded causal intervention on a predeclared anatomical branch, no global retuning.
B.legal_information: Frozen flow taps, anatomical graph, receptor signs and original state; no desired turn signal.
B.prediction: Identified branch intervention changes DNb05 target and command contrast while preserving peripheral drive.
B.falsifier: Target is not in a low-sensitivity regime or branch intervention leaves DNb05/command contrast unchanged.
B.control: Sham matched intervention and numerical reference; label any model change as new candidate, not recovery of old gate.

C.mechanism: Closed-loop environmental feedback or temporal accumulation may be necessary for spatial correction, rather than immediate intensity contrast.
C.new_operation: From matched state, compare online finite-source feedback with a yoked replay of actually consumed odor after a fixed small body perturbation.
C.legal_information: Only current antenna pose for online arm; replay uses a donor sequence registered before target run, never a target heading.
C.prediction: Online controller adjusts command and reduces source-distance error versus replay across a predeclared longer horizon.
C.falsifier: Online and replay remain equivalent in command or source-distance trajectories, or body/odor clocks fail pairing.
C.control: Same initial state, perturbation, contact physics, source, energy and budget; do not assume improvement from longer unperturbed S+/S-.

next_discriminator: No candidate promoted before external comparison and a new frozen organism budget; cheap CPU checks of geometry/signed-flow sensitivity may prune A or B.
stop: This round ends after external analysis and a ranked discriminating design. No Stage4 pass claim and no source/threshold retune of campaign24.
